title: Rank of finite flat pushforward on a constant-rank open
statement: Let f : X → Y be a finite, flat and locally finitely presented morphism of schemes. Let U be an open of Y and n a natural number. If the morphism rank f.finrank is n at every point of U, then the restriction to U of f_* O_X is finite locally free of rank n.

proof.text: For a finite flat locally finitely presented morphism with globally constant finrank n, use the already proved isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isAffineHom and isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_of_isAffineOpen. On each affine open V, finite_app, finitePresentation_appLE and flat_appLE give finite presentation and flatness of Gamma(X,f^-1 V). The cartesian affine chart square and finrank_SpecMap_algebraMap identify its rankAtStalk with f.finrank; hence the affine criterion gives rank n. This is the private proved helper rank_pushforward_unit.

Transport fixed-rank local generators along the site equivalence between the open subscheme U and Over U. The private proved helper rank_pushforward_site maps each free generating family along the corresponding colimit-preserving functor; its cover is the family of objects equipped with a morphism to an original cover object. Cocontinuity gives the covering property and mapFreeIso preserves the generating index type. Specialize this to overEquiv U to obtain the private proved helper rank_over_of_restrict.

Construct the direct-image restriction comparison for any module M and any scheme morphism f: (f_*M)|U is isomorphic to (f|U)_*(M|f^-1 U). Use pushforwardComp and pushforwardCongr2, with the equality image_morphismRestrict_preimage on each open. Compatibility of the ring actions is precisely morphismRestrict_app. This proves the private helper pushforward_restrict_iso without a derived base-change assumption.

Apply finrank_of_isPullback to the restriction square to make f|U globally rank n. Apply step 1 to f|U, transport its structure-sheaf pushforward through step 3 and restrictUnitIso, and apply step 2. All constructions allow an empty U and n=0.

proof_origin.place: Tags 02KB and 04MH; implemented using the proved affine fixed-rank criterion in WeilConjectures/AlgebraicGeometry/Modules/LocallyFreeRank.lean and direct restriction comparisons.
